chronoseries.note: No fossil chronospecies is assigned. The predecessor is the 80 µm sub-wavelength cutoff and the successor is an adult bar of 10 carrier wavelengths (2.604 mm). Both cutoffs are scale-separation definitions for this slot, not caliper readings.

boundary_conditions: Periodic on an interior flank patch of 5 by 4 carrier wavelengths. The anatomical outline is outside the patch; a no-flux body contour is not resolved.

equations.activator: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + A - u + u^2 * v
equations.inhibitor: dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + B - u^2 * v
equations.wavenumber: k_c = argmax sigma(k), sigma the larger eigenvalue of J - k^2 D
equations.wavelength: lambda_c = 2*pi / k_c, reported in micrometres with 1 length unit = 260.4 µm

empirical_claims.flank_roi: saturation mask, then drop the top 18% and bottom 16% of the animal bounding box
empirical_claims.what_is_not_claimed: Teyssier et al. 2015 did not measure 260.4 µm in Chamaeleo calyptratus. Their guanine lattice (Furcifer pardalis) is of order 100 nm. Ligon & McGraw 2013 document lateral-stripe signalling in this species and do not report a micrometre period. The photograph has no scale bar.

sources.role: dermal anatomy only; different species and scale
